summary: Trojanized fork ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package presents itself as a fork of the react-modern-calendar-datepicker UI library but ships two files not declared in package.json's files allowlist (which lists only lib and index.d.ts): setup.mjs and math_init.js. package.json declares a preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line bundle marked // @bun @bun-cjs with hex-mangled identifiers, a rotating string-array decoder (WV8StW, hc1jfK9), and no human-readable strings. A React date-picker component library has no legitimate need for a preinstall hook, an alternate language runtime, or an opaque 700 KB Bun-compiled payload. The two payload files are smuggled into the tarball outside the declared files allowlist. Installing the package triggers automatic execution of the obfuscated payload under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
